1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 20 m de altura, de copa redonda y frondosa, hojas de margen aserrado y flores fragantes de color amarillo, agrupadas en racimos cortos; tiene diversos usos en medicina tradicional. (Sterculiaceae; Guazuma ulmifolia).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching a height of up to 20 m, with a rounded and dense canopy, leaves with serrated margins and fragrant yellow flowers grouped in short racemes; it has various uses in traditional medicine. (Sterculiaceae; Guazuma ulmifolia).
